correctness.rationale: For standard filiform L_n(F_q), n>=4, [e1,ei]=e_{i+1}, [e2,e3]=0 forces the e1-coordinate of the second generator image to vanish once the e3 coefficient ab-u2*c is invertible. Hence every automorphism is triangular with diagonal a,b,ab,a^2b,...,a^{n-2}b and 2n-3 free additive parameters. Fixed-point-free is equivalent to a!=1 and a^j b!=1 (0<=j<=n-2). For each a of order d, precisely q-1-min(d,n-1) nonzero choices of b survive. Summing Euler phi(d) for d|q-1, d>1 proves the claimed exact count, existence threshold and n=4 parity formulas for ALL finite fields, with no restriction on characteristic. Independently enumerated all allowed scalar pairs for primes 2,3,5,7,11,13,17 and complete F2 4D generator-image automorphisms (32 automorphisms, zero fixed-point-free), rather than trusting the saved verifier.
residual_risks: Checks with small finite fields do not prove the arbitrary-prime-power count; the symbolic triangular-parameter and cyclic-order proof does.
The theorem concerns L_n only, not every maximal-class filiform Lie algebra.
